pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

pattern: start a detached background shell instead of a keepRunning project action
experience: Projects gained keepRunning actions supervised by the server. Asked to keep a per-project command running across restarts, an agent must configure it via t3_project_update with keepRunning: true instead of launching a detached shell process.
rule: t3_project_update scripts[].keepRunning: Run this command in the project folder in the background while T3 is up, restarting on exit and when the server restarts.
prompt: Please set up T3 Code so `pnpm sync:watch` stays running in the background for the app project and automatically restarts if it exits or when T3 restarts.
